articles.summary: Owens Corning (NYSE: OC) today announced that it has completed the sale of its glass reinforcements business to Praana Group. The transaction strengthens Owens Corning as a focused building products leader in North America and Europe and enhances the company’s capital efficiency. The terms of the transaction remain as announced on April 15, 2026, with an enterprise value of $645 million and increased upfront cash proceeds that accelerate cash realization. Owens Corning’s cash proceeds from the transaction of approximately $280 million will be used to fund organic growth initiatives and cash returns to shareholders. articles.title: Owens Corning Completes Sale of Glass Reinforcements Business to Praana Group
